task.title: Using the bootstrap token for zero-touch deployment
task.shortdesc: To provision Red Hat Quay resources without using the UI, you can use the bootstrap OAuth token as Bearer authentication for organization, application, and token API calls.

step.cmd: Export the bootstrap token. For example:
Create an OAuth application in the organization:

info.codeblock: $ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN" -X POST \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"name": "ci-automation", "description": "CI/CD token source"}' \ https://<quay-server.example.com>/api/v1/organization/myorg/applications

step.cmd: Create a scoped OAuth API token for the application:
Store the token value from the response for your automation workflow. The token secret is returned only in the create response.
